summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to provide an update on its net asset value (NAV) as of May 31, 2026, and the transaction price for July 1, 2026. The filing discloses the NAV per share by class, derived from appraised properties and valued debt, overseen by the adviser and independent valuation advisors. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The update is a routine monthly NAV disclosure, typical for a non-traded REIT, without any imminent corporate action. The filing is not considered a special situation requiring further event-driven analysis.
